name: beyond_get_project_overview
description: Get high-level Platform project overview. Compact mode is the default and includes only model information in schema-related data, plus last_checkout and relevant_documents summaries. Use beyond_list_checkpoints to fetch older checkpoint/checkout messages. Use beyond_get_document to fetch a specific relevant document; fetch all HUMAN-authored documents if they are not already in memory.For project setup with supplied requirements (Excel/docs/chat), do not stop at acknowledgement: check existing BE records, save traceable DRAFT requirements within the requested scope, verify saved IDs, then ask focused gap questions. Reuse prior agreement and answered questions. Reading/summarizing alone does not authorize writes. Without supplied requirements, offer an interview. Applicable intake and next-stage guides are inline. ALWAYS save BE ANALYSIS_CONTENT as Markdown.

project_id.description: Target project identifier returned by beyond_list_projects or beyond_get_context

detail_level.description: compact returns project metadata and model-only schema information with entities/processors/attributes/transformations counts per model; name-only returns logical name, physical name, ID, and counts in hierarchy; full returns detailed overview data.

force_clone.description: Force cloning the project if never checked out before

response_format.description: auto returns inline when small and switches to paged delivery when the response exceeds max_inline_bytes. full disables automatic paging. paged forces paged delivery.

max_inline_bytes.description: Maximum serialized structuredContent size to return inline when response_format is auto.

page_size_bytes.description: Maximum JSON text fragment size per page when paged delivery is used.

include_json_content.description: When false, omit duplicated JSON from text content and rely on structuredContent.

output_contract_note: No outputSchema is declared by the inspected public source definition. Consult live help and actual results; do not infer a missing output contract.
